publication.title: Some uniform effective results on André–Oort for sums of powers in C^n
publication.venue: Mathematical Proceedings of the Cambridge Philosophical Society180(2026),607–641
publication.corrections: Exact published A065 scope reused from independent sieve-bounds review; no new full-source audit.

available_assertion.statement: For an imaginary quadratic order, the singular moduli are roots of a monic integral class polynomial, hence are algebraic integers.
available_assertion.objects: Classical elliptic singular moduli of imaginary quadratic orders.
available_assertion.hypotheses: The elliptic curve has geometric complex multiplication by an imaginary quadratic order.
available_assertion.quantifiers: Every imaginary quadratic order, including nonmaximal orders.
available_assertion.parameter_range: Negative order discriminants; elliptic curves in characteristic zero.
available_assertion.uniformity: Algebraic integrality for all such singular moduli.
available_assertion.constants: No numerical height bound or discriminant estimate used.
available_assertion.normalizations: Use the classical elliptic Weierstrass c4^3/discriminant invariant and the full CM order, including nonmaximal orders.
available_assertion.exceptional_cases: No maximal-order restriction; this is not a formula for a quaternionic Hauptmodul.
available_assertion.limit_order: Fix the CM order and form its class polynomial.

rows.needed: The actual nonsingular E_ell with classical j=35152/9 has no geometric complex multiplication.
rows.connecting_argument: If E_ell had geometric CM, its endomorphism order, not necessarily maximal, would make its classical elliptic j an algebraic integer by the monic integral order class polynomial. For a reduced rational a/b, multiplying a monic equation by b^n gives b dividing a^n, hence b=1. Here35152 is not divisible by3, so35152/9 is not integral. Contradiction.

retained_inputs.statement: The displayed nonsingular model has the computed classical j invariant; ell is nonzero.

rows.boundary: This application does not supply open image, a uniform index, or any assertion about the distinct CM generator curve. The earlier derived non-CM output is not a premise.
